echo x >> ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.example.plist
cp com.example.plist $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/
echo x | tee /Library/LaunchAgents/com.example.plist
curl -o ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.example.plist https://example.org/p
echo x>~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.example.plist
echo x 1>$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.example.plist
echo x &>~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.example.plist
echo x > /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.example.plist
cp -t ~/Library/LaunchAgents com.example.plist
sudo cp com.example.plist ~/Library/LaunchDaemons/
